scenes: Twelve Asian cities. Twelve different summers.
In four, a heat plan is in force. | In five, parts are in place. | In three, we found no published city plan yet.
Each city has something to share: | Ahmedabad’s plan, the region’s first; | Dhaka’s chief heat officer; | Bangkok’s cooling centres; Singapore’s heat stress advisory.
